svg.text: kv — the whole command surface
kv — klanker-voice operator CLI for access codes and tiers
Usage:
kv [command]
Available Commands:
code Manage access codes (create, list, expire)
completion Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
help Help about any command
killswitch View or flip the site-wide voice kill-switch (D-08/D-09)
knowledge Regenerate KPH's curated packs + retrieval indexes (D-07)
smoke Prove offer -> ICE connected -> RTP-flow against the voice service (KV-05)
studio Start the local kv studio operator console (127.0.0.1 only)
telephony Operator overview of the inbound-telephony surface (DIDs, gate secrets, gate config)
tier Manage tiers (session/period/concurrency limits)
voipms Automate the API-drivable VoIP.ms provisioning steps (D-03)
Flags:
--endpoint-url string Override DynamoDB endpoint (for dynamodb-local dev/testing)
-h, --help help for kv
--log-level string Log verbosity level (debug, info, warn, error) (default "info")
--profile string AWS shared-config profile (default "klanker-application")
--region string AWS region (defaults to us-east-1; AWS_REGION env overrides)
--table string DynamoDB table name (default "kmv-auth-electro")
--usage-table string Voice usage DynamoDB table name (default "kmv-voice-usage")
Use "kv [command] --help" for more information about a command.
